verdict.rationale: A direct probe found no llms.txt at the docs site (HTTP 404), and no evidence shows agent-oriented documentation published for agents to consume. The OpenAPI spec and Swagger UI are API-reference artifacts that belong to a separate story, so they earn no credit here, and the generic web-scraping feature is adjacent at best.
